mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ranking_cache ( trip_id, title, image_url, ranking, score, temperature, weather, region, reason ) VALUES ( #{tripId}, #{title}, #{imageUrl}, #{rankNo}, #{score}, #{temperature}, #{weather}, #{region}, #{reason} )
mapper.select: SELECT ranking AS rankNo, trip_id AS tripId, title AS title, image_url AS imageUrl, score AS score, temperature AS temperature, weather AS weather, region AS region, reason AS reason FROM ranking_cache ORDER BY ranking ASC LIMIT 5
